# Naive RAG Is a Strong Baseline for Agent Memory

###### Abstract
We find that naive retrieval over raw history matches complex agentic memory systems, with gaps of 0.13 to 5.53 points across four benchmarks. These findings challenge the necessity of complex agentic memory and establish naive RAG as an essential baseline. Code is released on github. The method is evaluated on several public benchmarks and compared against strong baselines under matched budgets.

## 1 Introduction
